trigger: Current native position 2 spends multiple calls on versioned maps after the business artifact passes.
candidate_action: Reuse an unchanged map for the next action, and avoid reading implementation source to reconstruct the protocol.
applicability: Same project, phase and bound revision; no changed output, input, interface, ledger or tool bytes.
action_difference: None in this observed applicable condition: baseline already stores and consumes the map and performs no implementation-source lookup. Changed binding still requires regeneration.
falsifier: A fresh applicable baseline trace demonstrably rebuilds an unchanged map or reconstructs protocol from implementation, and a consumed qualified rule changes that action.
withdrawal: Any stale-map use after binding change; any holdout qualification loss or unproven net saving.
disposition: retain-baseline; reject before program generation or utility slots
scope: one screening only; distinct from rejected two-copy serial family; does not rename or reset that historical family
statistical_budget: No new policy state or evaluation created; historical failure/selection archives unchanged.
